comment: BGB/D is the abbreviation as written (like ZPO/ZH), so the /D suffix belongs inside the OTHER_LAW span; pre-annotator cut before /D. VIII ZR 164/03 is a German BGH file number -> no span (was JOURNAL_REF). Art. 96 lit. b e contrario i.V.m. Art. 106 Abs. 2 BGG: kept as BARE_ARTICLE + STATUTE because e contrario interrupts the chain (analogous to the bracketed-remark rule); not settled by the guideline. § 133 des bürgerlichen Gesetzbuches (BGB/D) stays BARE_ARTICLE (act given as a title).
